title: feature: assembler/disassembler
description: Create an assembler and a disassembler
steps:
Create:
- apps/assembler.c
- apps/disassembler.c

Run:
- assembler on each of our example code .isa, make sure it creates the .bin files.
- disassembler on each of our example code .bin, make sure it creates the .isa files.

Model your work after `test\exponentiation\exponential-5.bin and .isa`. That one preserves comments so that'd be a bonus.
